source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Unit 5 (PDF 83-92), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 5 (Partial Fractions) ke poore unit se practice MCQs hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah, jis mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Expressing a rational function as a sum of partial fractions is called:
(Rational function ko partial fractions ke jama ki shakal mein likhna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik rational function ko saada fractions (partial fractions) ke jama mein likhna partial fraction resolution (tahleel) hai.

book_ref.quote: Expressing a rational function as a sum of partial fractions is called Partial Fraction Resolution.

blocks.prompt:
2 \(\dfrac{2}{x+1} + \dfrac{1}{x-2}\) equals:
(\(\dfrac{2}{x+1} + \dfrac{1}{x-2}\) kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mushtarik denominator \((x+1)(x-2)\): \(2(x - 2) + 1(x + 1) = 3x - 3\). Oopar neeche alag alag jama karna (\(\frac{3}{2x-1}\)) ghalat hai.

book_ref.quote: In this unit we shall learn how to reverse the order in (i) and (ii)

blocks.prompt:
3 Which of the following is an identity?
(In mein se kaun si identity (mutabiqat) hai?)
blocks.explanation: \((x + 2)^{2}\) ko phailane se bilkul \(x^{2} + 4x + 4\) milta hai, is liye har \(x\) par sahi. Baqi sirf khaas qeematon par sahi hain (\(x = 2\); \(x = \pm 2\); \(x = 0, 1\)).

book_ref.quote: Identity: It is an equation which holds good for all values of the variable

options.text: kisi bhi x par sahi nahi

blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} - 5x + 6 = (x - 2)(x - 3)\), jo sirf \(x = 2\) aur \(x = 3\) par 0 hai; \(x = 0\) par \(6 \ne 0\), is liye identity nahi.

book_ref.quote: Conditional equation: It is an equation in which two algebraic expressions are equal for particular values of the variable

blocks.prompt:
5 The symbol \(\equiv\) is read as:
(Nishan \(\equiv\) ko kaise parhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(\equiv\) ko \"is identically equal to\" parhte hain; yeh identity ki nishani hai jo har qeemat par sahi ho.

book_ref.quote: is read "is identically equal to"

blocks.prompt:
6 Which of the following is a rational fraction?
(In mein se kaun sa rational fraction hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rational fraction \(\frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}\) hai jahan \(P(x)\), \(Q(x)\) polynomials hon aur \(Q(x) \ne 0\). \(\sqrt{x}\) aur \(2^{x}\) polynomials nahi, aur denominator 0 nahi ho sakta.

book_ref.quote: is called a rational fraction. A rational fraction is of two types.

blocks.prompt:
7 Partial fraction resolution is an extremely valuable tool in the study of:
(Partial fraction resolution kis ke mutalie mein bohat qeemti auzaar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Unit ke mutabiq yeh calculus mein bohat qeemti auzaar hai, mushkil rational function ko saada fractions mein todne ke liye.

book_ref.quote: It is an extremely valuable tool in the study of calculus

blocks.prompt:
8 Which of the following is a proper rational fraction?
(In mein se kaun sa proper rational fraction hai?)
blocks.explanation: Proper: numerator ki degree < denominator ki degree. Sirf \(1 < 2\) theek hai; baqi mein \(2 = 2\), \(3 > 2\), \(1 = 1\).

book_ref.quote: is called a Proper Rational Fraction if the degree of the polynomial

blocks.prompt:
9 The degree of \((x - 1)^{2}(x + 3)\) is:
(\((x - 1)^{2}(x + 3)\) ki degree kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hasil-e-zarb ki degree factors ki degrees ka jama hai: \(2 + 1 = 3\).

book_ref.quote: its degree is the sum of the degrees of its factors

blocks.prompt:
10 The degree of the non-zero constant polynomial \(5\) is:
(Ghair-sifar constant polynomial \(5\) ki degree kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(5 = 5x^{0}\), is liye ghair-sifar constant ki degree 0 hai. Is liye \(\frac{5}{x + 2}\) proper hai (\(0 < 1\)).

book_ref.quote: a non-zero constant has degree 0, because

blocks.prompt:
11 The fraction \(\dfrac{12x^{2}}{x^{3} + 1}\) is:
(Fraction \(\dfrac{12x^{2}}{x^{3} + 1}\) kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf degrees ginti hain: numerator ki degree 2, denominator ki 3, is liye \(2 < 3\): proper. Coefficient 12 se farq nahi parta.

book_ref.quote: The size of the coefficients does not matter.

blocks.prompt:
12 Which of the following is an improper rational fraction?
(In mein se kaun sa improper rational fraction hai?)
blocks.explanation: Improper: numerator ki degree \(\ge\) denominator ki degree. \(2 = 2\), is liye \(\frac{x^{2} - 1}{x^{2} + 4}\) improper hai; barabar degrees bhi improper hain.

book_ref.quote: is called an Improper Rational Fraction if the degree of the polynomial

blocks.prompt:
13 By long division, \(\dfrac{2x^{2} - 3x + 4}{x - 2}\) equals:
(Lambi taqseem se \(\dfrac{2x^{2} - 3x + 4}{x - 2}\) kis ke barabar hai?)

book_ref.quote: Any improper rational fraction can be reduced by division to a mixed form

blocks.prompt:
14 When \(x^{3} + 2\) is divided by \(x - 1\), the remainder is:
(\(x^{3} + 2\) ko \(x - 1\) par taqseem karne se baqi kya bachta hai?)

book_ref.quote: the sum of a polynomial and a proper rational fraction

blocks.prompt:
15 If \(ax^{2} + bx - c = 3x^{2} - 5x + 2\) for all \(x\), then \(c\) equals:
(Agar har \(x\) ke liye \(ax^{2} + bx - c = 3x^{2} - 5x + 2\) ho to \(c\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Constant terms barabar karein: \(-c = 2\), is liye \(c = -2\). (Saath \(a = 3\), \(b = -5\).)

book_ref.quote: the polynomials have same degree and the coefficients of like powers of the variable in both the polynomials must be equal

blocks.prompt:
16 When a rational fraction is separated into partial fractions, the result is:
(Jab rational fraction ko partial fractions mein alag kiya jaye to natija kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Natija identity hai: domain of identity mein variable ki har qeemat par sahi.

book_ref.quote: When a rational fraction is separated into partial fractions, the result is an identity

blocks.prompt:
17 The domain of the identity \(\dfrac{2x^{2} - 3x + 4}{x - 2} = 2x + 1 + \dfrac{6}{x - 2}\) is:
(Identity \(\dfrac{2x^{2} - 3x + 4}{x - 2} = 2x + 1 + \dfrac{6}{x - 2}\) ka domain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono taraf defined honi chahiye; denominator \(x - 2\) \(x = 2\) par sifar hai, is liye identity har \(x \ne 2\) par sahi hai.

book_ref.quote: for which both sides are defined

blocks.prompt:
18 Before resolving \(\dfrac{x^{2} + 3x + 4}{(x + 1)(x + 2)}\) into partial fractions, we must first:
(\(\dfrac{x^{2} + 3x + 4}{(x + 1)(x + 2)}\) ko partial fractions mein todne se pehle kya zaroori hai?)

options.text: numerator ko x se zarb dena
taqseem, kyun ke fraction improper hai

blocks.explanation: Numerator aur denominator dono ki degree 2 hai, is liye fraction improper hai; pehle taqseem: \(1 + \frac{2x + 2}{(x + 1)(x + 2)}\).

book_ref.quote: Equal degrees already make a fraction improper

blocks.prompt:
19 If \((p - 1)x^{2} + (q + 2)x + (r - 4) = 0\) for all values of \(x\), then \((p, q, r)\) is:
(Agar \(x\) ki har qeemat par \((p - 1)x^{2} + (q + 2)x + (r - 4) = 0\) ho to \((p, q, r)\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jo polynomial har \(x\) par sifar ho us ke sab coefficients 0 hain: \(p - 1 = 0\), \(q + 2 = 0\), \(r - 4 = 0\).

book_ref.quote: A non-zero polynomial of degree 3 can be zero for at most 3 values of

blocks.text: 5.1.3 Resolution of a Rational Fraction P(x)/Q(x) into Partial Fractions

blocks.prompt:
20 The first point in resolving \(\frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}\) into partial fractions is to make sure that:
(\(\frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}\) ko partial fractions mein todne ka pehla nukta kya hai?)

options.text: \(Q(x)\) ka koi linear factor na ho

blocks.explanation: Qadam (i): \(P(x)\) ki degree \(Q(x)\) se kam honi chahiye; warna taqseem karein aur sirf baqi wala fraction todein.

book_ref.quote: must be less than that of

blocks.prompt:
21 The correct form of the partial fractions of \(\dfrac{x + 5}{(x - 1)(x + 2)}\) is:
(\(\dfrac{x + 5}{(x - 1)(x + 2)}\) ke partial fractions ki sahi shakal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Case I: har ghair-mukarrar linear factor ko aik fraction milta hai jis ke oopar constant ho.

book_ref.quote: when Q(x) has only non-repeated linear factors

blocks.prompt:
22 In \(\dfrac{x + 5}{(x - 1)(x + 2)} = \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{B}{x + 2}\), the value of \(A\) is:
(\(\dfrac{x + 5}{(x - 1)(x + 2)} = \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{B}{x + 2}\) mein \(A\) ki qeemat kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Each zero of a linear factor switches off all the other unknowns.

blocks.prompt:
23 In the same identity, the value of \(B\) is:
(Isi identity mein \(B\) ki qeemat kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: For Case I this substitution is the fastest way.

blocks.prompt:
24 The partial fractions of \(\dfrac{5x + 4}{(x + 2)(x - 1)}\) are:
(\(\dfrac{5x + 4}{(x + 2)(x - 1)}\) ke partial fractions kya hain?)

book_ref.quote: Multiply the identity with the denominator of left hand side.

blocks.prompt:
25 How many unknown constants are needed to resolve \(\dfrac{P(x)}{(x - 1)(x + 2)^{2}(x^{2} + 1)}\) (a proper fraction)?
(\(\dfrac{P(x)}{(x - 1)(x + 2)^{2}(x^{2} + 1)}\) (proper fraction) ko todne ke liye kitne na-maloom constants chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Na-maloom ki tadaad = \(Q(x)\) ki degree \(= 1 + 2 + 2 = 5\): \(\frac{A}{x-1} + \frac{B}{x+2} + \frac{C}{(x+2)^{2}} + \frac{Dx + E}{x^{2}+1}\).

book_ref.quote: The number of unknown constants always equals the degree of

blocks.prompt:
26 \(\dfrac{1}{x(x + 1)}\) resolved into partial fractions is:
(\(\dfrac{1}{x(x + 1)}\) ke partial fractions kya hain?)

book_ref.quote: Equate the coefficients of like terms

blocks.prompt:
27 \(\dfrac{x^{2} + 5x + 1}{x(x + 1)}\) in partial fractions is:
(\(\dfrac{x^{2} + 5x + 1}{x(x + 1)}\) ke partial fractions kya hain?)

book_ref.quote: Resolving an improper fraction without dividing first

blocks.prompt:
28 Before resolving \(\dfrac{4x + 5}{x^{2} + x - 2}\), the denominator is factorized as:
(\(\dfrac{4x + 5}{x^{2} + x - 2}\) ko todne se pehle denominator ke factors kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Do numbers jin ka hasil-e-zarb \(-2\) aur jama \(1\) ho: \(2\) aur \(-1\). Is liye \(x^{2} + x - 2 = (x + 2)(x - 1)\), aur jawab \(\frac{1}{x + 2} + \frac{3}{x - 1}\).

book_ref.quote: Factor the denominator \(Q(x)\) into its irreducible factors

blocks.prompt:
29 The correct form of the partial fractions of \(\dfrac{x^{2} + 5}{(x - 2)^{3}}\) is:
(\(\dfrac{x^{2} + 5}{(x - 2)^{3}}\) ke partial fractions ki sahi shakal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Case II: mukarrar factor \((x - a)^{n}\) ke liye 1 se \(n\) tak har power ka aik fraction; yahan \(n = 3\).

book_ref.quote: When Q(x) has repeated linear factors

blocks.prompt:
30 In \(\dfrac{3x + 1}{(x - 1)^{2}} = \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{B}{(x - 1)^{2}}\), the value of \(B\) is:
(\(\dfrac{3x + 1}{(x - 1)^{2}} = \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{B}{(x - 1)^{2}}\) mein \(B\) kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: gives only the constant over the highest power

blocks.prompt:
31 In \(\dfrac{x + 3}{(x + 1)^{2}(x - 1)} = \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{B}{x + 1} + \dfrac{C}{(x + 1)^{2}}\), the value of \(B\) is:
(\(\dfrac{x + 3}{(x + 1)^{2}(x - 1)} = \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{B}{x + 1} + \dfrac{C}{(x + 1)^{2}}\) mein \(B\) kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: The others come from equating coefficients.

blocks.prompt:
32 In \(\dfrac{x^{2} + x + 2}{x^{2}(x + 1)} = \dfrac{A}{x} + \dfrac{B}{x^{2}} + \dfrac{C}{x + 1}\), the value of \(C\) is:
(\(\dfrac{x^{2} + x + 2}{x^{2}(x + 1)} = \dfrac{A}{x} + \dfrac{B}{x^{2}} + \dfrac{C}{x + 1}\) mein \(C\) kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Writing only \(\frac{B}{(x+2)^{3}}\) for a repeated factor

blocks.prompt:
33 Fully factorized, the denominator \((x - 1)^{2}(x^{2} - 1)\) is:
(Poore factors ke saath denominator \((x - 1)^{2}(x^{2} - 1)\) kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: (difference of squares) hides a third factor

blocks.prompt:
34 Which of the following quadratic factors is irreducible?
(In mein se kaun sa quadratic factor irreducible (na-qabil-e-tajziya) hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(b^{2} - 4ac = 4 - 20 = -16 < 0\): koi haqeeqi root nahi, is liye \(x^{2} + 2x + 5\) haqeeqi linear factors mein nahi tootta. Baqi toot-te hain: \((x-1)(x+1)\), \((x+1)(x+2)\), \((x-2)^{2}\).

book_ref.quote: A quadratic factor is irreducible if it cannot be written as the product of two linear factors with real coefficients.

blocks.prompt:
35 Over a non-repeated irreducible quadratic factor \(ax^{2} + bx + c\), the numerator of the partial fraction is:
(Ghair-mukarrar irreducible quadratic factor \(ax^{2} + bx + c\) ke partial fraction ka numerator kaisa hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Neeche degree 2 hai, is liye proper fraction ke oopar degree 1 tak ho sakti hai: \(\frac{Ax + B}{ax^{2} + bx + c}\).

book_ref.quote: A constant alone would not be enough.

blocks.prompt:
36 In \(\dfrac{x^{2} + 3}{(x^{2} + 1)(x + 1)} = \dfrac{Ax + B}{x^{2} + 1} + \dfrac{C}{x + 1}\), the value of \(C\) is:
(\(\dfrac{x^{2} + 3}{(x^{2} + 1)(x + 1)} = \dfrac{Ax + B}{x^{2} + 1} + \dfrac{C}{x + 1}\) mein \(C\) kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: may be written as the identity having partial fractions of the form

blocks.prompt:
37 The factorization of \(x^{3} - 1\) used for partial fractions is:
(Partial fractions ke liye \(x^{3} - 1\) ke factors kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: \((x - 1)(x^{2} + x + 1) = x^{3} - 1\); quadratic ka \(b^{2} - 4ac = 1 - 4 = -3 < 0\), is liye irreducible hai.

book_ref.quote: is irreducible when its discriminant

blocks.prompt:
38 \(x^{4} + x^{2} + 1\) factorizes as:
(\(x^{4} + x^{2} + 1\) ke factors kya hain?)

book_ref.quote: makes a perfect square, and then the difference of squares factorizes

blocks.prompt:
39 The partial fractions of \(\dfrac{2x}{x^{4} + x^{2} + 1}\) are:
(\(\dfrac{2x}{x^{4} + x^{2} + 1}\) ke partial fractions kya hain?)

book_ref.quote: A quadratic factor has no real zero to substitute

blocks.prompt:
40 In \(\dfrac{3}{x^{3} - 1} = \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{Bx + C}{x^{2} + x + 1}\), the value of \(A\) is:
(\(\dfrac{3}{x^{3} - 1} = \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{Bx + C}{x^{2} + x + 1}\) mein \(A\) kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Putting a constant over an irreducible quadratic instead of

blocks.prompt:
41 How many unknown constants appear in the partial fractions of \(\dfrac{x + 4}{(x - 1)(x^{2} + 1)}\)?
(\(\dfrac{x + 4}{(x - 1)(x^{2} + 1)}\) ke partial fractions mein kitne na-maloom constants hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{A}{x - 1} + \frac{Bx + C}{x^{2} + 1}\): teen constants, jo denominator ki degree \(1 + 2 = 3\) ke barabar hain.

book_ref.quote: Linear factor: constant on top.

blocks.prompt:
42 The correct form of the partial fractions of \(\dfrac{P(x)}{(x^{2} + 4)^{2}}\) (proper) is:
(\(\dfrac{P(x)}{(x^{2} + 4)^{2}}\) (proper) ke partial fractions ki sahi shakal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Case IV: mukarrar irreducible quadratic ki har power ka aik fraction, har aik ka numerator linear. \(x^{2} + 4\) haqeeqi factors mein nahi tootta.

book_ref.quote: When Q(x) has repeated irreducible quadratic factors

blocks.prompt:
43 The partial fractions of \(\dfrac{x^{3} + 2x}{(x^{2} + 1)^{2}}\) are:
(\(\dfrac{x^{3} + 2x}{(x^{2} + 1)^{2}}\) ke partial fractions kya hain?)

book_ref.quote: Case IV combines the two earlier ideas
is a repeated irreducible quadratic (Case IV)

blocks.prompt:
45 A student writes \(\dfrac{x + 5}{(x - 1)(x + 2)} = \dfrac{2}{x - 1} + \dfrac{1}{x + 2}\). Putting \(x = 0\) on both sides shows that:
(Aik talib-e-ilm likhta hai \(\dfrac{x + 5}{(x - 1)(x + 2)} = \dfrac{2}{x - 1} + \dfrac{1}{x + 2}\). Dono taraf \(x = 0\) rakhne se kya pata chalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bayan: \(\frac{5}{(-1)(2)} = -\frac{5}{2}\). Dayan: \(-2 + \frac{1}{2} = -\frac{3}{2}\). Mukhtalif hain, is liye doosre fraction ka nishan ghalat hai; sahi jawab \(\frac{2}{x - 1} - \frac{1}{x + 2}\) hai.
